I am evaluating a trade offer in Monopoly.

Accepting the offer would give me $450 cash but cost me both orange properties. That would let p2 claim the orange monopoly.

Rejecting the trade is the clear choice. I am now weighing a counter-offer for New York Avenue to complete my own orange set.

Vermont is a poor counter target because p4 already holds the other light blue properties. I am now considering offering cash plus another property for New York Avenue, though I must ensure I retain enough cash to build houses.

Building houses on New York Avenue would cost $900, but I only have $685. Even a modest bid for the property would leave me unable to construct meaningful improvements. The pink set is also under construction.

Virginia is too expensive to build on. I would still lack the cash for a full set of houses.

The orange monopoly would be especially dangerous. p2 would have roughly $629 left after the trade and could immediately build six houses, raising rent to the $200 range.
